docs.title: Cisco Systems | Cloud Engineering Technical Leader
docs.text:
Aug 2019 – July 2026 (Remote)

Managed FedRAMP Moderate operations, backend data systems, and critical infrastructure for the Webex for Government platform, before transitioning in 2024 to the central SecOps engineering team to expand vulnerability management, automated tooling, and technical leadership across corporate Webex systems.

  • DevSecOps & Compliance Automation: Developed automated reporting tools using the Qualys API to extract compliance metrics. Engineered Python scripts to parse raw STIG XCCDF (XML) data and map it to compliance results, enabling the automated generation of audit-ready STIG checklists. This compliance-as-code bridge eliminated hundreds of manual audit hours.
  • Data Platform Engineering: Designed, deployed, and operated a vulnerability management platform using Python (Pandas, SQLAlchemy) and PostgreSQL. Built custom ETL pipelines to ingest and synchronize data from the Jira API, providing teams with high-fidelity dashboards for severity tracking and SLA compliance. Integrated data with Tableau to enable executive-level visibility into remediation progress.
  • Inventory Analytics & Infrastructure Operations: Leveraged Pandas for large-scale data manipulation, merging disparate inventory reports and datasets into actionable operational insights across Cisco UCS bare-metal hardware and cloud compute. Transformed manual Excel-based tracking into automated trend analysis for monthly executive reporting.
  • Zero-Day Incident Response (Log4j): Engineered and executed enterprise-wide Ansible playbooks during the 2021 Log4j vulnerability to perform deep filesystem audits across all running server fleets. Located dormant instances embedded in nested packages and non-standard directories that bypassed standard Qualys scans, auditing 100% remediation across the platform.
  • Technical Guidance & Mentorship: Served as infrastructure team lead, providing technical direction across the Webex for Government environment. Mentored engineering teams in methodical troubleshooting and supported the analysis and resolution of complex vulnerability and compliance remediation issues, ensuring continuous service stability under strict SLAs.
  • Skills: Python (Pandas, SQLAlchemy), PostgreSQL, Jira API, Qualys API, STIG Compliance (XCCDF/XML), ETL Pipelines, Tableau, Ansible, RHEL/Ubuntu, Cisco UCS, FedRAMP Moderate.

docs.title: Cisco Systems | Cloud Systems Engineer
docs.text:
Jan 2017 – Aug 2019 (Remote)

Managed and optimized mission-critical compute infrastructure for Webex Commercial and FedRAMP environments. Collaborated with Networking and Storage teams to ensure zero-downtime availability, robust identity access control, and high security across US data centers.

  • Enterprise Identity Architecture: Architected and deployed a High-Availability (HA) FreeIPA cluster to replace a legacy, high-overhead 389 Directory Server environment. Automated VM deployment in OpenStack using Ansible, enabling centralized RBAC and HBAC for 2,000+ Linux/Windows servers and infrastructure devices across multiple data centers.
  • Virtualized Infrastructure Operations: Managed large-scale compute services using vSphere on Cisco UCS hardware. Administered critical infrastructure including bastion hosts, LDAP/FTP servers, and antivirus solutions, ensuring consistent high availability.
  • Vulnerability Management: Led security patch remediation efforts for compute services in highly regulated federal environments. Researched and implemented system security patches, advised engineering teams on remediation strategies, and managed Qualys vulnerability scanners to maintain strict compliance.
  • Skills: Ansible, FreeIPA, OpenStack, VMware vSphere, Cisco UCS, RHEL/CentOS, Windows Server, RBAC/HBAC, Qualys, FedRAMP Compliance.

docs.title: Select Group @ Cisco | Cloud DevOps/QA Engineer (Contract)
docs.text:
Feb 2016 – Jan 2017 (Remote)

Provided specialized DevOps and QA engineering support for Cisco’s OpenStack-based Public Cloud (InterCloud Services). Focused on performance optimization, automated configuration management, and stability engineering for large-scale cloud deployments.

  • Performance Optimization: Identified and removed redundant Nova Scheduler filters, reducing instance scheduling time for 700 nodes from 20 seconds to 5 seconds—a 75% improvement in orchestration speed.
  • Infrastructure-as-Code at Scale: Engineered and executed Ansible playbooks to manage complex bare-metal configurations through lights-out management (LOM) interfaces and automated cron jobs across hundreds of production servers simultaneously.
  • Cloud Infrastructure Evaluation: Stood up RHUI (Red Hat Update Infrastructure) and Proxmox clusters for Proof-of-Concept (PoC) assessments to determine viability for integration with Cisco InterCloud Services.
  • Stability Engineering: Diagnosed and resolved a critical race condition involving cloudbase-init on Windows 2008/2012 images within OpenStack, eliminating intermittent reboots during initial instance setup.
  • Cloud QA & Orchestration: Managed global test cycles for Compute and Heat components during major cloud upgrades. Developed Python and Bash scripts coupled with Ansible to perform comprehensive orchestration tests.
  • Skills: OpenStack (Nova, Heat, Neutron, Glance), Ansible, Python, Bash, RHUI, Proxmox, Linux/Windows Administration, Performance Tuning, Cloud QA.

docs.title: Australian Laboratory Services | Senior Systems & Storage Administrator
docs.text:
Sep 2014 – Jan 2016 (Grand Junction, CO)

Managed, modernized, and optimized enterprise storage, virtualization, database, and network infrastructure. Engineered high-availability distributed storage clusters, automated server provisioning, and implemented comprehensive monitoring to ensure maximum uptime, data integrity, and network performance.

  • Distributed Storage & Virtualization: Engineered an Ubuntu-based Ceph cluster for VMware ESXi hosts, benchmarking iSCSI vs. RBD performance to optimize block storage access. Leveraged Ceph RBD snapshots to manage automated database schema testing, enabling a major production database upgrade with zero errors.
  • Infrastructure Automation: Implemented SaltStack to manage Linux virtual environments and automate the configuration and rapid provisioning of new Ceph storage nodes and virtual machine resources.
  • Database & Data Integrity: Wrote custom Python (SQLAlchemy) verification scripts to check for missing SQL foreign keys and ensure data integrity during major migrations. Configured replication and backups of production MySQL databases using LVM snapshots and rsync.
  • System Stability & Monitoring: Installed Observium for performance telemetry and integrated proactive checks into Nagios to monitor production systems, decreasing service restarts from weekly to quarterly.
  • Network Hardware Engineering: Troubleshot and resolved a complex routing issue where Asterisk VoIP traffic was throttled by backup data tunnels; replaced overloaded gateway hardware, doubling available network bandwidth.
  • Skills: Ubuntu/CentOS, VMware ESXi, Ceph RBD, iSCSI, SaltStack, Python (SQLAlchemy), MySQL, Nagios, Observium, Asterisk VoIP, Cisco/HP Routers & Switches, Sophos UTM, VLANs, IPsec VPN.

docs.title: Garfield County School District 16 | Senior Systems/Network Administrator
docs.text:
Oct 2002 – Jun 2014 (Parachute, CO)

Managed and modernized the district-wide enterprise network, systems, and core educational platform infrastructure. Led high-impact IT modernization projects, automated administrative processes, and engineered cost-effective systems that dramatically reduced operational costs and IT support overhead.

  • Systems Integration & Automation: Developed a custom Flask (SQLAlchemy) web application that synchronized the centralized Student Information System (SIS) with Active Directory and Google Apps. Built self-service password reset and status tools for teachers, resulting in a 97% reduction in recurring support calls to the helpdesk.
  • Enterprise Modernization & Development: Spearheaded the replacement of a legacy, fragmented student information system with a web-based, centralized platform, eliminating manual data syncing between schools. Streamlined state compliance reporting by developing custom PHP generation scripts interfacing with the PostgreSQL database.
  • Infrastructure & Systems Virtualization: Designed and administered virtualized host environments using Citrix XenServer and VirtualBox to run critical Windows Server 2008 and Ubuntu Linux servers. Supervised low-voltage cabling and hardware installation contractors for new facilities to ensure strict specification compliance.
  • Network Engineering: Engineered a high-speed WAN connection between district buildings using Ruckus wireless bridges, increasing bandwidth by 6,500% (1.5Mbps to 100+ Mbps) with zero ongoing monthly service costs. Managed core networking infrastructure including Cisco Routers, Switches, PIX Firewalls, and Smoothwall web filters.
  • Unified Communications & End-User Compute: Deployed Cisco CallManager and Cisco Unity voice systems district-wide. Architected a centralized desktop computing solution using Windows Terminal Servers and HP Thin Clients for 6 computer labs, saving the district over $60,000 in capital expenditure and simplifying end-user support.
  • Skills: Python, Flask, SQLAlchemy, PHP, PostgreSQL, Ubuntu, Windows Terminal Server, Windows AD, Citrix XenServer, VirtualBox, Cisco CallManager/Unity, Cisco Routers & Switches, PIX, Ruckus Wireless Bridges/APs, HP Thin Clients, Google Apps, Smoothwall, Active Directory.

docs.title: Summary executive
docs.text: Senior Systems & Platform Engineer with a 30-year foundation beginning in U.S. Air Force avionics, specializing in rigorous system validation, infrastructure automation, and data integrity. Proven track record of mastering complex, unfamiliar architectures and becoming an organizational SME. Architect of robust ETL pipelines (Python/SQL) that enforce data quality at the source to deliver authoritative sources of truth. An objective, fact-based troubleshooter who translates intricate system, storage, and networking data into resilient operational workflows that fix the core infrastructure issues hindering operations teams and executives.
